name: Ensnaring Bridge, Kraken of the Straits — power compared with an amount in the subject
notes: Found by tests/sweep.py (subject probe: Ensnaring Bridge reached nobody at hand size 7). 'Creatures with power greater than the number of cards in your hand' and 'Creatures with power less than the number of Islands you control' had no reading of the amount; the can't-rule block in cards-parser.js now counts it with _computeForEachCount for the source, 'you' being its controller, and builds the subject from the words before 'with' only (the 'you control' in the amount is not the subject's). Hand size 2 (Player 1's; the count reads the Bridge controller's hand, see hand-counts-read-the-named-player): Hill Giant (3) and the opponent's Craw Wurm (6) can't attack, Grizzly Bears (2) can. I control two Islands, the opponent three: Llanowar Elves (1) can't block the Kraken, Grizzly Bears (2) can (it could if all five Islands were counted). Memory: project_bess_base_pt_and_amount_in_subject_2026-10-14.

scryfallData.name: Ensnaring Bridge
scryfallData.oracle_text: Creatures with power greater than the number of cards in your hand can't attack.
scryfallData.flavor_text:
"When I said I needed a hand, I didn't mean this."
—Gerrard Capashen

scryfallData.name: Kraken of the Straits
scryfallData.oracle_text: Creatures with power less than the number of Islands you control can't block this creature.
scryfallData.flavor_text: Thassa felt no need to punish the sailors for their folly in crossing the straits. The kraken would do it for her.

scryfallData.name: Grizzly Bears
scryfallData.flavor_text:
"We cannot forget that among all of Dominaria's wonders, a system of life exists, with prey and predators that will never fight wars nor vie for ancient power."
—Jolrael, empress of beasts

scryfallData.name: Hill Giant
scryfallData.flavor_text: Fortunately, hill giants have large blind spots in which a human can easily hide. Unfortunately, these blind spots are beneath the bottoms of their feet.

scryfallData.name: Craw Wurm
scryfallData.flavor_text: The most terrifying thing about the craw wurm is probably the horrible crashing sound it makes as it speeds through the forest. This noise is so loud it echoes through the trees and seems to come from all directions at once.

scryfallData.name: Llanowar Elves
scryfallData.flavor_text: The elves of the Llanowar forest have defended it for generations. It is their sacred duty to keep outside influences from corrupting their ancestral home.
